cells.tense: Here, with the pen, right now.
cells.verb: Following your own thinking all the way down into the pattern.
cells.place: In the middle of becoming what you actually are.
cells.ask: Offer to sit with one thing your heart already knows and just stay there — let that recognition be enough company, no one absorbed into anyone else, and notice what steadies when you stop reaching past it.
cells.core:
You can follow a thread of your own thinking all the way down. Not chasing someone else's idea of what's true — going into the pattern until it opens, and coming back with something you can hand to another person. That depth isn't a talent you perform. It's what your mind does, and it's the ground of whatever you're building into.

The thinking is doing what it's for. The seeing goes deep and it comes back up usable.
cells.sheetLine: You can go deep into your own thinking and bring something true back up.

cells.tense: Somewhere ahead of here, already braced.
cells.verb: Going so deep into the pattern there's no way back out to anything solid.
cells.place: Wherever you're trying to become something before it's actually here.
cells.ask: Offer one clear shape you already know in your own mind — say it plainly, out loud, to one person, and let them be able to find it, instead of keeping the depth to yourself until it's perfect; when that's done you'll feel it too — things make sense in your presence.
cells.core:
The depth has stopped being a place you go and become a place you're hiding. Every question opens onto three more, and the further in you get, the further you get from anything you could stand on. You're not building toward all of that. You're just ahead of the ground.

The thinking runs, but it's running away from the deadline of being real.
cells.sheetLine: The depth has no floor and nothing down there is usable.

cells.tense: Still at a door already behind you.
cells.verb: Keeping your depth from ever meeting another person.
cells.place: Somewhere in becoming what you already are, but empty-handed.
cells.ask: Offer to bring the clearest thing you know to one small group of people you trust, not as the expert — as one voice among them — and let them meet the idea where it hits and lands, telling them in words that can travel; that's when the living transmission starts and the depth finds someone to go toward.
cells.core:
The inside is where the depth stays. You know the pattern well enough, but it never leaves the room you think it in — not until it goes out into someone else's hands, and instead you keep measuring the entrance to it. The going is real. The coming back up with it has gone quiet.

What's missing isn't the depth. It's the ground under your feet out where depth is shared.
cells.sheetLine: The depth stays in your head and doesn't reach anyone.

cells.tense: Here, pen moving, but you're calling it someone else's hand.
cells.verb: Living inside your own deep thinking while calling it something else.
cells.place: Becoming what you are, and attributing the becoming to the work itself.
cells.ask: Offer to sit with it until it steadies, then say one sentence as yours that you've been letting the work say — like the pattern you spotted, or the standard you keep — and let it stay yours while it's with someone else; when you do, what's been running you settles into something that recognizes both of you and doesn't merge you.
cells.core:
You've been running the depth for a long time — the long mornings, the pattern you keep finding, the thing you make when no one's watching. But you describe it as what the work asks for, as the project's own momentum. You're already the one doing the thinking, and you give that one to the room.

The thought is real. The hand on the pen has never been claimed.
cells.sheetLine: You're doing the thinking and calling it the work's.
